notes: Se conservan los prompts completos utilizados para producir estas siete insignias.
Las rutas de referencia están normalizadas al contenido del ZIP; se pasaron como referenced_image_paths.
Los prompts especifican una retícula lógica aproximada de 64 × 64; los PNG exportados tienen 1254 × 1254 píxeles.
Los títulos incluidos en los prompts son guía conceptual; no se dibujan sobre las insignias.
No se registró una semilla ni un modelo específico en la llamada. Una nueva generación puede variar.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone transparent pixel-art achievement badge for a cozy educational exploration video game called Bitácora Amorcito. Primary request: create one NEW badge in the same coherent set as the attached active-listening badge. Input image 1 is ONLY a STYLE and MEDAL TEMPLATE reference, not the new subject. Use the same frontal round medallion silhouette, chunky stepped circular embossed rim, upper-left pale pixel highlights, lower-right darker pixel shading, little squared corners and pixelated edge. Match the reference's small, limited-palette retro-game pixel language. Keep the symmetrical small leafy branches curving up around the lower left and lower right of the central symbol, recolored to harmonize with this badge. Replace the ear entirely with the subject specified below. Make the central symbol large and readable at game UI sizes. Low-resolution pixel art drawn on a consistent coarse approximately 64 by 64 pixel logical grid, enlarged cleanly with nearest-neighbor-looking solid square pixel clusters. Flat color clusters, crisp square corners, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients, no noise texture, no vector-style soft edges, no photorealism, no 3D render. Square canvas. Center exactly one medal taking up about 86 percent of the canvas width with an even transparent margin, all elements fully inside the round silhouette. True transparent alpha background OUTSIDE the medal; the inner disc stays opaque. No text, no lettering, no numerals, no labels, no watermark, no extra icons outside the medal, no contact sheet. Treat the learning title and meaning only as conceptual guidance, never print words.
Learning and reflective meaning: Plantas y semillas · Curiosidad que florece
New central subject: Two small golden sunflowers with brown seed centers and green stems, one taller than the other, inspired closely by image 2. Simplify the sunflower bouquet to two flowers and just a few leaves, no extra orange flower. They symbolize noticing where plants begin, valuing germination, and curiosity about nature.
Palette: green embossed rim as in the original reference, deep forest-green inner disc, golden sunflower petals, warm brown seeds, fresh green leaves
